content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SRM University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SRM University Project Fellow Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Fellow: Master's degree in Psychology (MA/MSc Psychology), Basic knowledge of research methodology and psychological research, Ability to undertake field-based research, Good communication skills in Haryanvi, Hindi and English

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 28 years. Age Relaxation: Upper age limit may be relaxed up to 5 years for SC/ST/PwD and 3 years for OBC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SRM University Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:srmuniversity.ac.in . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by SRM University for filling up available project positions in Sonepat, Haryana under government sector guidelines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised in this recruitment notification is Project Fellow, offering a great opportunity for qualified psychology professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Fellow position under this recruitment notification released by SRM University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for SRM University Project Fellow Recruitment is strictly offline. Interested candidates must send their filled applications via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form for the Project Fellow position is 24-10-2026. Ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years as of 01-10-2026, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology (MA/MSc Psychology) along with research methodology knowledge and good communication skills.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000 per month throughout the contract period.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories to apply for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Fellow post includes shortlisting of candidates followed by email intimation for further stages.
